_readme: Curated per-game emulation fixes imported into ArcadeGameProfile via `arcade-gameconfig-import`. Reviewed + source-cited; NOT auto-pulled (no clean machine-readable per-game DB exists). SAFETY on forcedFps — it is a BLUNT instrument: it paces the WHOLE game to a fixed rate. It is only correct for games that run at ONE rate everywhere AND double-speed in our stack. Games with MIXED rates (e.g. Sonic Adventure: 60fps menus/logo + 30fps gameplay) get their 60fps sections HALVED and the audio desyncs — verified on Sonic 2026-07-05. A self-limiting 30fps game would also be halved. So all forcedFps entries are demoted to 'medium' pending a better fix (the proper solution for Sonic-class games is a frame-increment+physics-multiplier ROM patch applied via cheats, or resolving why our stack double-speeds gameplay when stock flycast does not). Core-option fixes (coreOptions) carry no such risk. See docs/arcade-per-game-config.md.

fixes.title: Sonic Adventure
fixes.notes: 30fps gameplay with physics tied to the frame limit → runs 2x in our stack. BUT the DC logo + menus are genuine 60fps: forcedFps 30 fixes gameplay speed & cutscene-audio clipping yet HALVES the logo/menus and desyncs audio (observed). Real fix = frame-increment+multiplier physics patch (PkR 'Better 60 FPS'), not a static pace. Held at medium.

fixes.title: Sonic Adventure - Limited Edition
fixes.notes: Same engine as Sonic Adventure — same mixed 60fps-menu / 30fps-gameplay caveat.

fixes.title: Sonic Adventure 2
fixes.notes: Same engine family — mixed-rate caveat applies.

fixes.title: Skies of Arcadia
fixes.notes: Native 30fps; community reports double-speed in emulation. Reverted after the Sonic finding — likely has 60fps menus too; needs per-game verification before forcedFps is trusted.

fixes.title: Shenmue
fixes.notes: Confirmed native 30fps on Dreamcast. Reverted after the Sonic finding pending verification of whether any sections are 60fps (which forcedFps would halve).

fixes.title: Grandia II
fixes.notes: Confirmed 30fps on Dreamcast. Reverted after the Sonic finding pending verification (menus/battle may differ).
